RAM VERMA

SUMMARY

Over 9 years of experience in the IT industry, with strong expertise as a Technical Lead in US Healthcare application support,specializing in RIS, PACS, and imaging integrations. Delivered L2/L3 production support across radiology environments using UNIX-based servers, log analysis, and monitoring to ensure high availability. Strong hands-on experience with PACS platforms, DICOM workflows, image routing, and viewer access. Skilled in HL7 interface troubleshooting using Cloverleaf and SQL queries to analyze orders, studies, and interface issues for faster incident resolution and RCA. Experienced in incident management, SLA adherence, and vendor coordination while ensuring HIPAA-compliant data security.

EXPERIENCE

Delivery Senior Specialist, 7/2026-current NTT Data



Provided technical and functional expertise for US healthcare applications, supporting end-to-end healthcare delivery workflows and business operations.

Managed L2/L3 production support activities, ensuring timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and application issues within defined SLAs.



Analyzed healthcare workflows, system integrations, and data flows across RIS, PACS, EHR/EMR, HL7, and other healthcare platforms.



Collaborated with clients, business stakeholders, product teams, and technical teams to identify requirements, resolve issues, and deliver effective solutions.



Performed root cause analysis and impact assessment for critical production issues while driving preventive and corrective actions.



Supported process improvements, knowledge management, compliance initiatives, and continuous service enhancements across healthcare technology solutions.

Technical Lead, 06/2026 – 07/2026 Infinite Computer Solution



Led L2/L3 production support teams, ensuring high availability and timely resolution of critical healthcare application incidents.



Provided technical leadership for RIS/PACS applications, HL7 interfaces, databases, and healthcare system integrations.

Managed incident, problem, change, and release activities while

ensuring adherence to SLA and operational standards.



Performed root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and performance optimization to minimize recurring production issues and downtime.



Collaborated with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and infrastructure teams to drive technical solutions and successful implementations.

CONTACT Address: 560035

Phone: 7292067823

Email: sram61195@gmail.com

HL7    UNIX  Cloverleaf  EPIC  Sybase  SQL Server Management Studio  Putty  Vagrant  Tomcat  Service Now  Control-M  Splunk  Bash Scripting  Jira  GIT    Loggly BMC Remedy Python

PACS RIS

improved support processes, and drove automation and continuous service improvement.

Performed troubleshooting and production support for .NET-based applications, analyzing application errors, logs, database issues, and system performance to identify root causes and resolve incidents efficiently.



Technical Lead, 05/2022 - 06/2026 CitiusTech



hands-on experience in Healthcare Interoperability, supporting data exchange across US healthcare systems.



Strong experience with HL7 v2 messaging (ADT, ORM, ORU), including message analysis, acknowledgements, and data mapping.

Worked with CCDA clinical documents for exchange of patient demographics, orders, results, and clinical summaries.

Working knowledge of FHIR resources and REST APIs (Patient,

Encounter, Observation, Diagnostic Report).



Experience using Cloverleaf Integration Engine to monitor, troubleshoot, and support healthcare interfaces.



Exposure to US healthcare data models and workflows, including patient registration, scheduling, orders, results, and clinical documentation.



Independently troubleshot production interoperability issues, resolving message failures, data discrepancies, and interface outages.



Performed root cause analysis (RCA) using integration engine logs, application logs, and system diagnostics.

Used SQL queries to analyze backend healthcare data and validate



clinical transactions. Applied basic scripting/programming skills (shell scripting) to support automation and troubleshooting tasks.

Software Engineer, 02/2021 - 05/2022 Qwikcilver Solutions



Provided L2 production support for business-critical applications, ensuring system stability and timely issue resolution.

Monitored application and process alerts, proactively identifying and

resolving incidents to minimize downtime.



Developed and executed SQL queries/scripts to investigate and resolve database-related issues reported by users.



Supported application deployments, coordinating activities and validating successful releases.





Performed post-deployment functional testing to ensure application stability and expected behavior. Analyzed application and system logs to diagnose issues, perform root cause analysis, and support permanent fixes.

Moody's Investors Services is the subsidiary of Moody's that is associated with its credit rating business. It is primarily divided into three portions viz. Corporate, Public and Structured Finance.
